questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of building a personal goal system, as discussed in Chapter 10?

options.text: To impress teachers and peers with complex planning tools
To create a repeatable, personalized process for setting and achieving goals that fits your lifestyle
To focus only on academic goals without considering other life areas
To avoid reflecting on progress and focus solely on future tasksCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: According to Chapter 10, what is a key benefit of conducting an annual goal review?

options.text: It allows you to ignore past mistakes and only set new goals
It helps you reflect on wins and setbacks, celebrate progress, and reset for the year ahead
It focuses only on failures to ensure you don’t repeat them
It eliminates the need to adapt goals to changing circumstancesCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: What is a crucial step in adapting goals to a changing world, as outlined in Chapter 10?

options.text: Sticking to the original plan no matter the circumstances
Assessing the core idea of your goal and brainstorming new ways to achieve it when faced with change
Abandoning all goals when unexpected challenges arise
Ignoring external changes and focusing only on personal effortCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: Why is becoming a goal mentor important, according to Chapter 10?

options.text: It allows you to control others’ goals and decisions
It reinforces your own goal-setting skills, builds leadership, and helps others succeed
It focuses only on teaching complex systems that others may not understand
It is solely about gaining recognition for your achievementsCorrect Answer: B
